data.long_meaning: The name Ghaysah is derived from the Arabic word 'gha'iya' which means 'revenge' or 'retribution'. It is mentioned in the Quran in the context of the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) and his brothers who sold him into slavery and later felt remorseful for their actions. Ghaysah can symbolize the pursuit of justice and the idea of making amends for past wrongs.
